policy.judge: Each suite keeps its own executable or human grading contract; model-judged scores never become deterministic oracle passes.
policy.comparison: Freeze task, judge, profile and runtime hashes; pair identical tasks; retain every failed attempt and all input plus output tokens.
policy.holdout: Protected disjoint task identities and traces never reach the proposer; development and sealed confirmation stay separate.
policy.promotion: At least250 unique main tasks, paired exact p<0.05 and at least6 net wins, at least10 disjoint holdout tasks, no input-plus-output tokens-per-solve or peak regression, independent functional and adversarial receipts.
policy.missing: Unavailable suites and unknown costs remain explicit; neither counts as zero, passed or complete.
policy.claims: Software fixtures are not model capability, native20x, subscription, useful-days, reboot or power-loss proof.
